text:
chris: Hey @people-ops — baby decided to come early, so I'm out starting today. Due date was next week but newborn arrived this morning. What paperwork do I need to get paid and keep benefits active? Also need a quick plan for oncall and equipment.

emily: Congrats!! :tada: First, huge congrats. Please file the leave request at https://redwood.hr/leave and upload the birth record when you have a copy. For primary caregivers, Redwood tops up STD to 100% for up to 8 weeks — you'll need to submit the STD claim. Can you confirm the dates you'll be OOO? CC your manager in the form.

chris: Thanks — wow. I expect OOO from today (1835129999) through next Monday (1835130000) but will update if we need more. Oncall: I can hand the pager off. Alex said earlier they'd cover if needed. Equipment: I left a monitor at my desk — do I need to drop it off or can we arrange pickup?

jonathan: Happy for you, congrats Chris. No formal sign-off required from me, but please CC me on the HR form. I can take over triage and pair with Alex for oncall handoff. Chris, please add a calendar block and paste the handover notes (quick link to the oncall doc).

alex: I can take Thu/Fri oncall. @jonathan let's do a 20–30m handoff in 15. I'll pick up the monitor unless facilities wants to collect it — easier for me to grab on my way in.

emily: For equipment pickup, facilities prefers a ticket so they can log assets. File a facilities ticket at https://redwood.tools/facilities and tag "pickup:monitor". If Alex picks it up, add the asset transfer note.

payroll-bot: Automated: Submit STD claim ID 55432 via https://redwood.hr/claims and attach required documentation (birth certificate or hospital discharge). Payroll processes STD/top-up within two payroll cycles after claim approval.

chris: Do I need to do anything for benefits to remain active? Also any action for 401k or health premiums?

emily: Benefits remain active while on paid leave. If you go into unpaid leave beyond the paid period, we'll send an enrollment continuity form. 401k contributions that are employer-paid as part of payroll will pause during unpaid time and resume when pay resumes — People Ops will confirm exact dates if needed.

chris: And travel / parking reimbursements for hospital runs — can I expense those?

emily: Yes, please submit receipts to people-ops@redwood.ai with subject "Expense - parental medical travel". We can approve reasonable hospital travel retroactively — include dates and brief notes.

jonathan: Alex, when you shadow tomorrow, I'll point you to the few flaky alerts and the current PRs needing quick review. Sarah from support can escalate urgent customer issues to our rotation.

alex: Got it. I'll open a short checklist in the oncall doc: `Handoff: pager creds, top-3 alerts, open PRs, escalation path` and ping Jonathan when ready.

sarah: If anything customer-facing pops, add me to the incident thread and I'll handle comms. Congrats Chris!! :heart:

chris: Thanks everyone. I'll fill the HR form now and upload docs. Appreciate the team picking up oncall and monitor :) Will DM if anything changes.

emily: Sending you the quick checklist DM now and will follow up with payroll timeline. Take care and congrats again! :sparkles:
